I or T: B1 [ I or T ] to join two pieces of cloth together by putting thread through them with a needle
› [ I or T ] to use a needle and thread to join up the edges of a cut in the skin or other part of the body
T: B1 [ T ] to make a piece of clothing by joining pieces of cloth together by putting thread through them with a needle

example: My grandmother taught me to sew.
我祖母教我做針線活。
I made this skirt just by sewing two pieces of material together.
我把兩塊料子縫在一起，就做成了這條裙子。
He sewed the badge neatly onto his uniform.
他把徽章精心地縫在制服上。
She sews all her children's clothes.
孩子們的衣服都是她縫製的。
The muscle layer needs to be sewn first.
先要縫合肌肉層。
His finger was cut off when he caught it in a machine, but the surgeon was able to sew it back on.
他的手指被機器夾住切斷了，不過外科醫生把斷指縫合上去了。

NONE: › to close or repair something by sewing the edges together

usually passive: › [ usually passive ] informal If you have a competition or game sewn up, you are certain to win it or get control of it.
確信能贏，對…勝券在握；視…爲囊中之物
› to complete all the arrangements for a successful business agreement

example: Let me sew up that hole in your jeans.
我來把你牛仔褲上的那個洞縫起來。
A nurse will come and sew up that wound for you soon.
馬上就有護士來爲你縫合傷口。
The Democratic candidate appears to have the election sewn up.
民主黨看來已確信會在選舉中獲勝。
It's going to take another week or two to sew up this deal.
要再花一兩個星期才能談妥這筆交易。

NONE: › waste matter such as water or human urine or solid waste
› the system of carrying away waste water and human waste from houses and other buildings through large underground pipes or passages

example: Some cities in the world do not have proper facilities for the disposal of sewage.
世界上的某些城市沒有適當的污水處理設施。
Raw/untreated sewage is being pumped into the sea, from where it pollutes our beaches.
未經處理的污水被排入大海，污染了我們的海灘。

NONE: › a place where sewage is treated so that it can be safely got rid of or changed into fertilizer
污水處理廠；汙物處理廠
› a large pipe, usually underground, that is used for carrying waste water and human waste away from buildings to a place where they can be safely got rid of
› a channel for carrying away waste water and waste from the human body that is above the ground and is not covered

example: a sewer pipe
排水管
A complicated system of sewers runs under the city.
城市的地底下布有複雜的排水系統。

NONE: › a piece of cloth that is being or needs to be sewn
縫製中的布料；待縫製的布料
C1 the skill or activity of making or repairing clothes or other things made from cloth

example: She put her sewing down.
她放下手裡的針線活。
I'm not very good at sewing.
我不太擅長做針線活。

NONE: › a machine that is used for joining together pieces of cloth, with a needle that is operated either by turning a handle or by electricity
